products.name: Krea AI
products.note: Real-time video generation; creative tool; content moderation; emerging platform

profile_text.body:
Krea is a creative AI platform that describes itself as "the world's most powerful creative AI suite," offering tools to generate, edit, and enhance images and videos. The platform aggregates a range of third-party frontier models alongside its own, including video models from ByteDance (Seedance Studio, Seedance 2.0 Mini), MiniMax (Hailuo), Google (Veo and Gemini Omni), and Alibaba, as well as image models from Google (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) and Alibaba (Qwen). Capabilities across these models include text-to-video generation, start and end frame animation, region-level editing, native synchronized audio, and multi-reference conditioning on images, video, and audio.

Krea has also released its own foundation image model, Krea 2, which the company describes as built from scratch with a focus on aesthetics, style transfer, and creative control. According to a benchmark cited on the site, Contra Labs found Krea 2 Large within 0.14 points of GPT Image 2 on Style Fidelity in a four-model style-transfer comparison. The platform also features FLUX 3, described as a single model spanning image, video, and audio that renders up to 20 seconds in one pass with multilingual speech, effects, and ambience. The held facts record one tracked product, Krea AI, categorized under video generation and editing, with no litigation, MCP servers, or SEC filings noted.
